Class TaskQueryService

java.lang.Object
com.owltask.task.service.TaskQueryService
public class TaskQueryService extends Object
Internal class grouping the task-reading use cases: UC-06 (list), UC-07 (details), UC-08 (search), UC-09 (filter/sort), UC-24 (error/empty states).

NOTE (temporary): reads workspace's ProjectRepository directly to resolve project names for the wire DTO, same stand-in shortcut TaskWriteService already takes - see its javadoc.
